# Canvas Runner

- **Genre:** Endless runner side‑scroll
- **Controls:** Space/Up arrow to jump
- **Gameplay:** A square character runs automatically across a procedurally generated platform. Gaps and obstacles appear; the player must time jumps to avoid them.
- **Lose condition:** Collision with an obstacle **or** falling into a gap ends the game.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible and achieve a high score based on distance traveled.

*Simple graphics and physics make it ideal for an HTML canvas implementation.*

<content>
1: // Endless runner (Canvas Runner) – concise implementation
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> is present in the page.
3: 
4: window.addEventListener('load', () => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 200;
9: 
10:   // Sound assets (simple data URLs)
11:   const jumpSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAIlYAAESsAAACABAAZGF0YQEAAAA='); // short click
12:   const hitSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAIlYAAESsAAACABAAZGF0YQIAAAAA'); // short thump
13:   const bgMusic = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRhYAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAIlYAAESsAAACABAAZGF0YQsAAAAA'); // placeholder silence loop
14:   bgMusic.loop = true;
15:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
16:   // start music after user interacts (first keydown)
17:   let musicStarted = false;
18: 
19:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
20:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
21:   const SPEED = 4; // scroll speed (px/frame)
22:   const GROUND_Y = HEIGHT - 30; // platform height
23: 
24:   const player = {x: 50, y: GROUND_Y - 20, w: 20, h: 20, vy: 0, onGround: true};
25:   let platforms = [{x: 0, w: WIDTH, y: GROUND_Y}]; // start with full ground
26:   let obstacles = [];
27:   let clouds = [];
28:   let frame = 0;
29:   let score = 0;
30:   let gameOver = false;
31: 
32:   const keys = {};
33:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') keys[e.code] = true; if (!musicStarted) { bgMusic.play(); musicStarted = true; } });
34:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') keys[e.code] = false; });
35: 
36:   function spawnSegment() {
37:     // Randomly create a gap or obstacle on the next segment
38:     const segWidth = 120 + Math.random() * 80; // 120‑200px segment
39:     const gap = Math.random() < 0.2; // 20% chance to have a gap
40:     const lastX = platforms.length ? platforms[platforms.length - 1].x + platforms[platforms.length - 1].w : WIDTH;
41:     if (gap) {
42:       // add empty space (no platform) – player will fall if not timed
43:       platforms.push({x: lastX + segWidth, w: segWidth, y: GROUND_Y});
44:     } else {
45:       platforms.push({x: lastX, w: segWidth, y: GROUND_Y});
46:     }
47:     // Occasionally add an obstacle on the platform
48:     if (!gap && Math.random() < 0.3) {
49:       const obsW = 15, obsH = 30;
50:       const obsX = lastX + segWidth / 2 - obsW / 2;
51:       obstacles.push({x: obsX, y: GROUND_Y - obsH, w: obsW, h: obsH});
52:     }
53:   }
54: 
55:   // Create a simple cloud for background
56:   function spawnCloud() {
57:     const w = 40 + Math.random() * 30; // width 40‑70
58:     const h = w * 0.6;
59:     const x = WIDTH;
60:     const y = Math.random() * (GROUND_Y - 80); // stay above ground
61:     clouds.push({x, y, w, h});
62:   }
63: 
64:   function update() {
65:     if (gameOver) return;
66:     // Input
67:     if ((keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp']) && player.onGround) {
68:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
69:       player.onGround = false;
70:       jumpSound.currentTime = 0;
71:       jumpSound.play();
72:     }
73:     // Physics
74:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
75:     player.y += player.vy;
76:     // Simple ground check against platforms under player
77:     player.onGround = false;
78:     for (const p of platforms) {
79:       if (player.x + player.w > p.x && player.x < p.x + p.w) {
80:         const platformTop = p.y;
81:         if (player.y + player.h >= platformTop && player.y + player.h - player.vy < platformTop) {
82:           player.y = platformTop - player.h;
83:           player.vy = 0;
84:           player.onGround = true;
85:         }
86:       }
87:     }
88:     // Fall off screen = lose
89:     if (player.y > HEIGHT) gameOver = true;
90:     // Move world left
91:     for (const p of platforms) p.x -= SPEED;
92:     for (const o of obstacles) o.x -= SPEED;
93:     // Move clouds (parallax, slower)
94:     for (const c of clouds) c.x -= SPEED * 0.5;
95:     // Remove off‑screen entities
96:     platforms = platforms.filter(p => p.x + p.w > 0);
97:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
98:     clouds = clouds.filter(c => c.x + c.w > 0);
99:     // Spawn new terrain as needed
100:     if (platforms.length === 0 || platforms[platforms.length - 1].x + platforms[platforms.length - 1].w < WIDTH) {
101:       spawnSegment();
102:     }
103:     // Occasionally spawn clouds
104:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnCloud();
105:     // Collision with obstacles
106:     for (const o of obstacles) {
107:       const coll = player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.w > o.x &&
108:                    player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.h > o.y;
109:       if (coll) { hitSound.currentTime = 0; hitSound.play(); gameOver = true; break; }
110:     }
111:     // Score based on distance
112:     score = Math.floor(frame / 60);
113:     frame++;
114:   }
115: 
116:   function draw() {
117:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
118:     // Draw background sky gradient
119:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
120:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light blue
121:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#fff');
122:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
123:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
124: 
125:     // Draw clouds (parallax)
126:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
127:     for (const c of clouds) {
128:       ctx.beginPath();
129:       ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w / 2, c.y + c.h / 2, c.w / 2, c.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
130:       ctx.fill();
131:     }
132: 
133:     // Draw platforms with slight shading
134:     const platGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, GROUND_Y - 10, 0, GROUND_Y);
135:     platGrad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
136:     platGrad.addColorStop(1, '#444');
137:     ctx.fillStyle = platGrad;
138:     for (const p of platforms) ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, HEIGHT - p.y);
139:     // Draw obstacles as dark triangles
140:     ctx.fillStyle = '#800';
141:     for (const o of obstacles) {
142:       ctx.beginPath();
143:       ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + o.h);
144:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
145:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
146:       ctx.closePath();
147:       ctx.fill();
148:     }
149:     // Draw player as a rounded square with gradient
150:     const pGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, player.y, 0, player.y + player.h);
151:     pGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4caf50');
152:     pGrad.addColorStop(1, '#087f23');
153:     ctx.fillStyle = pGrad;
154:     const radius = 4;
155:     ctx.beginPath();
156:     ctx.moveTo(player.x + radius, player.y);
157:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w - radius, player.y);
158:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y, player.x + player.w, player.y + radius);
159:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h - radius);
160:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h, player.x + player.w - radius, player.y + player.h);
161:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, player.y + player.h);
162:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h, player.x, player.y + player.h - radius);
163:     ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + radius);
164:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y, player.x + radius, player.y);
165:     ctx.closePath();
166:     ctx.fill();
167:     // UI
168:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
169:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
170:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
171:     if (gameOver) {
172:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
173:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,WIDTH,HEIGHT);
174:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
175:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
176:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH/2-70, HEIGHT/2);
177:     }
178:   }
179: 
180:   function loop() {
181:     update();
182:     draw();
183:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
184:   }
185: 
186:   // Kick off
187:   spawnSegment(); // initial extra segment
188:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
189: });

(End of file - total 189 lines)
</content>
